title: Your follow-up messages, for review
intro: These are the texts and emails LeadPro will send your leads, word for word. Mark each one **Looks good**, or click **Change it** and type the wording you'd like. Your answers save as you go, and nothing is sent until you approve.
footer: Prepared for The Mahdavi Law Firm by Law Firm Marketing Pros · November 2026 · You can come back to this page any time; your answers are saved.

sections.title: New lead we haven't reached yet
sections.sub: 5 texts and 3 emails over 4 days. Stops when your team reaches them.

msgs.text: Hi [First name], thank you for contacting The Mahdavi Law Firm. Someone from our team will call you shortly from [Firm phone]. If now isn't a good time, reply with a better time. Reply STOP to opt out.

msgs.subject: A few things to keep in mind after an accident
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

While you decide on next steps, a few things can help protect your claim:

- Keep copies of medical records, bills, photos and any police report.
- Be careful about giving a recorded statement to an insurance company before you get advice.
- Write down what you remember while it's fresh.

If you'd like to talk it through, call [Firm phone] or reply to this email.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team
Hi [First name], this is our last check-in from The Mahdavi Law Firm. If you'd still like help, reply YES or call [Firm phone] anytime. Reply STOP to opt out.

sections.title: Leads you couldn't reach, or who aren't ready yet
sections.sub: 6 emails over about 3.5 months. Stops on a reply, an unsubscribe or any card move.

msgs.subject: Why it helps to get answers early
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

Injury claims have legal time limits, and evidence like photos, witness details and medical records is easier to gather early. A short conversation now can help you understand where you stand, even if you decide not to move forward.

Call [Firm phone] or reply to this email.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

msgs.subject: If the insurance company calls
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

If an insurance adjuster contacts you, you don't have to answer every question or accept the first offer on the spot. It's worth getting advice first.

If you'd like to talk it through, call [Firm phone] or reply here.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team
